rule: Take /ds/companies names, unique and sorted. Drop any whose company_key (fetch_sec.py) matches one of the 194 in data/real_votes.csv. random.Random(2026).shuffle the rest, before any company or meeting fetch. Walk in that order. Look each name up with /query/company, keep results whose name equals the listed name, else whose company_key does. Drop a result whose id or company_key is among the 194, and one already taken. Skip a company with no listed meeting from 2026-01-01, or none with a cast vote (For, Against, Abstain, Withhold; direction is not read). Otherwise keep every meeting of that company, all years. Stop after the first name that brings the 2026 meeting count to at least 300.
note: The rule text still says 300 because it was first written for that target. The target then rose in steps from 300 to 1,000 meetings, along the same fixed name order, before the sealed run.
normalising: voteInstruction and managementRec stored as text. nbim_vote: For=FOR, Against/Withhold=MOT, Abstain=AVSTÅ, else blank. mgmt_rec same without Withhold. against_board: blank if either is blank, else 1.0 if they differ. item_no: position in the API response. rationale_text: publicRationaleOutgoing joined. rationale_section: exact text lookup from pre-2026 rows of real_votes.csv, OTHER if unseen. market: country map from real_votes.csv, blank if unmapped.
